svg.title: SMC top-level microarchitecture
svg.desc: Block diagram of the SMC top module, smc. It holds three blocks: the CPU cluster smc_cpu_wrapper, drawn as a black box; smc_base; and smc_peripherals. The CPU cluster has four Rocket RV64GC cores with their L1 caches, the scratchpad, the boot ROM interface, the PLIC, the CLINT, the debug module and per-core watchdogs. Its boot ROM (128 KiB), scratchpad (1 MiB in 32 banks) and L1 instruction and data cache tag and data arrays (4 KiB per core each) are memory macros outside the SMC, and JTAG enters its debug TAP. smc_base holds the fabric, the internal registers, the data accelerator and three AXI hang detectors. The input fabric, smc_input_fabric, takes the system inbound AXI port, the SEP inbound port, the DTP JTAG debug port, the CPU MMIO port, the log-engine fetch port from the UARTs and the data accelerator master. It sends traffic inside the SMC window to the local fabric on three paths (system, sep_in and local) and other JTAG, MMIO, log and DMA traffic to the output fabric, smc_output_fabric, which remaps and filters it onto the system outbound AXI port. The local fabric, smc_local_xbar, reaches the CPU front port, the data accelerator control port, the internal CSRs in smc_internal_regs through an AXI-Lite crossbar, the DFD block smc_dfd_wrap over APB, and the peripheral port. smc_base also drives the CPU interrupt vector. The DFD trace sink writes to eight external trace RAMs. In smc_peripherals the peripheral crossbar, smc_periph_axi_lite_xbar, has twelve targets: four UARTs with log engines, three I2C controllers, six I3C controllers and the AVSBus controller, each through a clock-domain crossing; the system timer OCTS; misc registers; the GPIO padring; three telemetry receivers; the reset unit; the eFuse wrapper; and two ports that leave the SMC, the DTP CSRs and the smc_external window for adopter peripherals such as the PLL, PVT and strap registers. The padring drives the GPIO pads, the telemetry receivers take ATB inputs, the reset unit takes the reset pins and drives subsystem resets and isolation requests, and the eFuse wrapper reaches the eFuse shim and bank and accepts OTP JTAG accesses from the DTP.
svg.text: CPU cluster: 4 × Rocket RV64GC, L1 caches (4 KiB I + 4 KiB D per core),
scratchpad, boot ROM I/F, PLIC, CLINT, debug module, per-core WDTs
Macro or block outside the SMC
